title: Photos | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: Photographs of the barn, the ell, the field and the patio at Hio Ridge in Bridgton, Maine, through the seasons. Weddings and events, May through October.
heading: The farm through the year
lede: Every photograph here was taken on the property by Susan. The first couples' photographs arrive with the first couples.
